name: Two Strings
description: A subsequence of length | x | of string s = s 1 s 2 ... s | s | (where | s | is the length of string s ) is a string x = s k 1 s k 2 ... s k | x | (1 ≤ k 1 < k 2 < ... < k | x | ≤ | s |) . You've got two strings — s and t . Let's consider all subsequences of string s , coinciding with string t . Is it true that each character of string s occurs in at least one of these subsequences? In other words, is it true that for all i (1 ≤ i ≤ | s |) , there is such subsequence x = s k 1 s k 2 ... s k | x | of string s , that x = t and for some j (1 ≤ j ≤ | x |) k j = i .
input_specification: The first line contains string s , the second line contains string t . Each line consists only of lowercase English letters. The given strings are non-empty, the length of each string does not exceed 2·10 5 .
output_specification: Print " Yes " (without the quotes), if each character of the string s occurs in at least one of the described subsequences, or " No " (without the quotes) otherwise.
approach_summary: Apply Knapsack and Basic Dynamic Programming paradigm under the Dynamic Programming (DP) framework. Exploit problem invariants to reduce state space and achieve optimal complexity.
